stem: Which statements BEST describe the purpose of this program following the Civil War?

options.text: It provided job training and education to formerly enslaved people.
It reestablished trade relationships between the North and the South.
It assisted with the distribution of food throughout the South.
It detailed the terms of the South being admitted back into the union.
It oversaw the forced migration of people to other parts of the country.

visual_elements: In the years following the Civil War, the Bureau of Refugees, Freedmen, and Abandoned Lands (the Freedmen’s Bureau) provided assistance to tens of thousands of former slaves and impoverished whites in the Southern States and the District of Columbia. —“African American Records: Freedmen’s Bureau,” National Archives, 2016
